title: Dartus
summary: Raleigh names Dartus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Printed Dartus, who began the canal after Sesostris and before Ptolemie the second. Not folded onto a Darius record. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter IV, §. I, sig. 184a
